description: The Building and Urban Data Science Laboratory publishes preprocessing examples for the IRIS rooftop thermal-image dataset. Three notebooks demonstrate file conversion, visualisation and analysis, with a separate image-conversion script. The README explains preparing the original image folders, converting JPGs to CSV, drawing object masks with Labelme and following temperatures in selected domains. Python source is free under MIT. The examples use a Singapore campus campaign, while coverage for new analysis depends on compatible images and masks. Derived series can support validation of building and neighbourhood simulations with model-energyplus. A caveat is that manual masks and camera-specific conversion affect the resulting observations, and the scripts do not implement a complete heat-transfer model. Original images are supplied separately. No images, dependencies or software were downloaded or executed.
